AUTOBATTLERMOD-RELIC.title: Relic
AUTOBATTLERMOD-ADD_RELIC_ON_RUN_START.ti: Add Auto Battler Relic at Run Start
AUTOBATTLERMOD-ADD_RELIC_ON_RUN_START.ho: If enabled, every new run starts with the Auto Battler relic. No, there is no other way to obtain it - this setting just allows you to turn the mod off for your next run. [red]If you want to turn the relic off mid-run, disable all other options instead.[/red]
AUTOBATTLERMOD-RELIC_GIVES_X_BONUS_ENERG: How much bonus Energy the Auto Battler relic gives at the start of each turn.
How many additional cards the Auto Battler relic allows you to draw at the start of each turn.
AUTOBATTLERMOD-AUTOMATION.title: Automation
AUTOBATTLERMOD-POTIONS_AUTO_PLAY.title: Auto Use Potions
AUTOBATTLERMOD-POTIONS_AUTO_PLAY.hover.d: Automatically uses available potions at the start of your turn. Does not use [gold]Foul Potion[/gold] or [gold]Fairy in a Bottle[/gold].
AUTOBATTLERMOD-MAX_POTIONS_PER_TURN.hove: The maximum number of potions that can be used automatically per turn. Set to [blue]0[/blue] for no limit.
AUTOBATTLERMOD-CARDS_AUTO_PLAY.title: Auto Play Cards
AUTOBATTLERMOD-CARDS_AUTO_PLAY.hover.des: Automatically plays all cards, similar to Whispering Earring.
AUTOBATTLERMOD-AUTO_END_TURN_WHEN_NO_PLA: Ends your turn automatically once no playable cards remain. [red]Only works when Auto Play Cards is enabled.[/red]
AUTOBATTLERMOD-MULTIPLAYER.title: Multiplayer
AUTOBATTLERMOD-STEAM64_IDS_MULTIPLAYER_F: Comma-separated Steam64 IDs of players who should receive the Auto Battler relic in multiplayer. Leave empty to grant the relic to all players. You can check your SteamID64 at [gold]steamid.io[/gold]. EXAMPLE VALUE: [blue]76561197960287930, 76561197998177443[/blue] - this will give the relic only to these two players. [red]ALL PLAYERS IN LOBBY SHOULD HAVE SAME SETTINGS, NOT ONLY HOST![/red]
